//@title alkaline
setcpm(125/4)

// remove the underscores before the $ to unmute tracks :)

//drumline
$: s("- hh - hh,[bd bd]").bank("bossdr220").fast(2)
  .lpf(3000).lpd(.9).room(.5)
  ._scope()._pianoroll()
_$: s("- hh [hh sd] <[- sd]*2>").bank("akailinn")
  .lpf(2000).delay(slider(1, .3, 1, .05)).room(.2).gain(.5)
  ._scope()._pianoroll()

//synthline (try playing these separately!)
_$: n("[0 2 4 <5 6 8>]").s("supersaw").scale("E:minor").fast(4).iter(2)
  .crush(12).delay(.4).gain(.8).lpf(slider(4460, 300, 6000, 10)).lpd(1.2)
  ._pianoroll()
$: n("10*2 4 [6 1] <- [8 1]>").s("tri").scale("E:minor").fast(2).transpose(5)
  .crush(16).gain(.6).delay(1)._pianoroll()

//bass
$: note("<[E1 -] [D1 -]> [- C1 C1 -]").s("supersaw").distort(1.5).slow(2)
  .lpf(slider(4580, 200, 8000, 10)).lpd(2)._pianoroll()

//@title LABORATORY
//@by homeroom

setcpm(130/4)
//this is an experimental environment meant to test functions 

//basic drumline
_$: s("<bd!2 [bd!4]>").bank("9000").room(.3).lpf(3000)
$: s("- hh!2 -").bank("ace").fast(4).delay(.3).lpf(3000).lpd(.3)
$: s("- sd").fast(2)

//experimenting with .struct and note lengths
_$: note("<ab3,f3 eb3,ab3 >").s("supersaw").struct("[x@3 x@1]").lpf(1000).lpd(.4).decay(.3).delay(.5)._pianoroll()
//using struct to create binary drum pattern
$: s("bd").struct("[1 0]!4").lpf(400)
$: s("sd").struct("[0 1]!2").lpf(700)
$: s("hh").struct("[0 1]").bank("ace").n("0 1 2 3").lpf(2000) //.n cycles through different hh samples here

//making bassline from reese samples
_$: n("<12 15> 22").sound("reese") //n cycles through samples
  .struct("x - - x - x x -")
  .decay(.5).lpf(5000).gain(.5)._scope()//synth line from samples
_$: n("5").sound("synth_cut")
  .struct("[- x] x x [- x]").fast(2)
  .decay(.3).delay(.5).crush(12)._scope()

_$: n("<4 6 7 8> [0 4]").s("tri").scale("Ab:major").fast(4).delay(.5).coarse(8).gain(.4)._pianoroll()
_$: s("bd(3, 8, 2)").lpf(400).distort(.5)
_$: s("sd").struct("[0 1]!2").lpf(1000).delay(.5)
_$: s("hh").struct("[ 0 1]").fast(4).lpf(3000).delay(.6)

$: n("c1@3 bb1@1 ab1@4").s("supersaw").slow(2)
